description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView that displays log data received through the LogNode interface, formatting log entries with severity, tags, messages, and exceptions.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that implements LogNode to display formatted log messages and supports chaining with other LogNodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data including priority, tag, message, and throwable, then updates the LogView and passes the data to the next LogNode if present.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Utility method to append a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line to the LogView.
